prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions were generally overoptimistic for non-winning tests, but underpredicted gains for winning tests.
sign_in hint, home wait_info, and adoption new_flow were helpful changes as each won a test.
choose_path copy changes showed no clear effect across 2 tests.
home redesign changes showed no clear effect across 2 tests.
Evidence remains thin for all other specific change types as each has only been tested once.

Changes:
0: [adoption, new_flow] Interactive Pet Photo Style Selector Flow: Adds an interactive style selector choice card during photo upload to allow users to preview and pick a rendering style before creation. (why: 3 support emails cited custom pet generation failing or looking unexpected.)
1: [sign_in, hint] Existing Account Pet Sync Notification Hint: Adds a explicit hint on the sign-in screen assuring users that signing in will automatically restore previously created pets. (why: 8 support emails (the highest reported issue) noted pets missing or reset after signing in again.)
2: [home, wait_info] Generation Progress Time Estimate Display: Displays an estimated remaining time and dynamic progress bar on the waiting screen during pet generation. (why: The waiting step has a mean duration of 2336s (over 38 minutes), leading to high drop-off due to lack of feedback.)
3: [home, notification] Desktop Pet Hatch Ready System Alert: Enables the system notification switch on the waiting screen to alert users when their pet has finished loading. (why: Home wait time is long (mean 2336s), so desktop notifications ensure users return when generation completes.)
4: [finish, copy] Desktop Pet Desktop Launch Headline Copy: Updates the headline and call-to-action button on the final home intro screen to direct users to look at their desktop. (why: 3 support emails reported that pets did not show on desktop or the app would not open.)
5: [choose_path, incentive] Quick Desktop Companion Choice Badge: Adds a badge on the path selection screen highlighting the fast setup path. (why: Choose path takes mean 514s; encouraging the quick adoption path reduces initial drop-off.)
6: [choose_path, layout] Story Screen Compact Layout Overview: Switches the story screen layout to compact to deliver intro context without extensive scrolling. (why: Initial path selection step has long mean duration (514s); a compact presentation speeds up early onboarding.)
